artifacts.name: cmd_validate
artifacts.description: Treat an inherited private strict-preview execution context as strict assertion, stub, and warning policy without recursively re-entering artifact coverage, and propagate that context only while running strict artifact coverage, including the strict side of strict-delta.

artifacts.name: run_coherence
artifacts.description: Public command helper that runs coherence once and returns the result used by validate output and exit status.

artifacts.name: run_validate_commands_for_result
artifacts.description: Command helper that runs manifest validate commands after structural validation succeeds.

artifacts.name: test_benchmark_parser_accepts_output_and_project_options
artifacts.source_scenario: A benchmark run is configured for an external project and explicit report files.

expected.behavior: The parser accepts project paths, repeat count, manifest directory, command prefix, JSON output, Markdown output, and JSON stdout options.

artifacts.name: test_changed_scope_handoff_docs_are_discoverable
artifacts.source_scenario: The README, agent skill guide, and draft workflow docs must make the default changed-scope handoff gate discoverable.

expected.behavior: The docs say maid verify runs changed-scope by default, show --base-ref/--since handoff commands, and describe E115 fail-closed behavior.

artifacts.name: test_full_option_spellings_still_parse
artifacts.source_scenario: Full option spellings for the same commands are used: `verify --manifest-dir`, `plan lock --no-run`, `test --manifest`.

expected.behavior: Full spellings parse to the same namespace values as before; disabling abbreviation does not change registered options.

artifacts.name: test_main_rejects_abbreviated_option_before_dispatch
artifacts.source_scenario: The CLI entry point receives the incident command shape end to end.

expected.behavior: main raises SystemExit with code 2 from argument parsing; no command handler output is produced.

artifacts.name: test_nested_command_parsers_survive_parser_extraction
artifacts.source_scenario: Nested command-family registration is extracted.

expected.behavior: `manifest create`, `graph query`, `chain log`, and `audit supersessions` keep their destination attributes and default manifest directories.

artifacts.name: test_nested_subcommand_option_abbreviation_rejected
artifacts.source_scenario: Prefix spellings are passed to nested subcommand families, e.g. `plan lock <manifest> --no-r` and `manifest create <file> --goal <goal> --dry`.

expected.behavior: Nested parsers inherit the no-abbreviation behavior and exit with SystemExit code 2.

artifacts.name: test_parser_exposes_verify_advisory_opt_out
artifacts.source_scenario: The CLI parser receives the verify advisory opt-out flag.

expected.behavior: The parser accepts the opt-out and stores it on verify args.

artifacts.name: test_parser_has_verify_subcommand
artifacts.source_scenario: The verify parser receives --changed-scope, --since, --base-ref, and --include-tests flags.

expected.behavior: The parsed Namespace exposes changed_scope=True, since, base_ref, and include_tests values.

artifacts.name: test_parser_help_lists_all_top_level_commands
artifacts.source_scenario: The benchmark command is registered as a top-level command.

expected.behavior: Formatted help includes benchmark along with the existing top-level commands.

artifacts.name: test_test_parser_accepts_jobs_option
artifacts.source_scenario: A user invokes the parser with `maid test --jobs 4`.

expected.behavior: The parsed namespace contains jobs=4 and existing batch flags still parse.

artifacts.name: test_test_parser_rejects_invalid_jobs_option
artifacts.source_scenario: A user invokes the parser with zero, negative, and non-integer jobs values.

expected.behavior: The parser rejects invalid jobs values before command execution.

artifacts.name: test_top_level_option_abbreviation_rejected
artifacts.source_scenario: A prefix spelling of a registered option is passed to a top-level subcommand, e.g. `validate --manifest-d`.

expected.behavior: Parsing exits with SystemExit code 2 instead of expanding the prefix to --manifest-dir.

artifacts.name: test_validate_accepts_changed_scope_flags
artifacts.source_scenario: The validate parser receives --changed-scope, --since, and --base-ref flags.

expected.behavior: The parsed Namespace exposes changed_scope=True plus the explicit since and base_ref values.

artifacts.name: test_validate_accepts_run_tests_flag
artifacts.source_scenario: The CLI parser receives validate --run-tests.

expected.behavior: The parser accepts --run-tests and stores it on validate args.

artifacts.name: test_validate_accepts_strict_assertion_stub_warning_flags
artifacts.source_scenario: The CLI parser receives validate strictness flags.

expected.behavior: The parser accepts --strict, --check-assertions, --check-stubs, and --fail-on-warnings.

artifacts.name: test_validate_compatibility_aliases_survive_parser_extraction
artifacts.source_scenario: The validate parser is extracted into a private helper.

expected.behavior: `validate --use-manifest-chain --json-output` still parses successfully with use_manifest_chain and json set to True.

artifacts.name: test_verify_changed_scope_defaults_on_and_can_be_disabled
artifacts.source_scenario: The verify parser receives no changed-scope flag and then receives --no-changed-scope.

expected.behavior: The default parsed Namespace has changed_scope=True and --no-changed-scope sets changed_scope=False.

artifacts.name: test_verify_rejects_manifest_option_abbreviation
artifacts.source_scenario: An agent runs the incident command shape `maid verify --require-plan-lock --require-red-evidence --manifest <file>` where verify defines --manifest-dir but not --manifest.

expected.behavior: Parsing exits with SystemExit code 2 and stderr names `--manifest`; the manifest file path is never accepted as a manifest directory.

artifacts.name: test_behavioral_validate_check_assertions_returns_1_for_no_assertions
artifacts.source_scenario: A behavioral test imports and calls the artifact but has no assertion.

expected.behavior: maid validate --mode behavioral --check-assertions --fail-on-warnings exits 1 with E210.

artifacts.name: test_coherence_flag_json_preserves_batch_failing_run_tests_and_coherence_result_in_single_document
artifacts.source_scenario: Directory-wide structural validation passes, but manifest validate commands and coherence both fail while --json output is requested.

expected.behavior: JSON output is one parseable document containing batch validation, failed tests, failed coherence details, and the command exits 1.

artifacts.name: test_coherence_flag_json_preserves_batch_failing_run_tests_result_in_single_document
artifacts.source_scenario: Directory-wide structural validation and coherence pass, but a manifest validate command fails while --json output is requested.

expected.behavior: JSON output is one parseable document containing batch validation, failed tests, and coherence results, and the command exits 1.

artifacts.name: test_coherence_flag_json_preserves_failing_run_tests_and_coherence_result_in_single_document
artifacts.source_scenario: Structural validation passes, but manifest validate commands and coherence both fail while --json output is requested.

expected.behavior: JSON output is one parseable document containing validation, failed tests, failed coherence details, and the command exits 1.

artifacts.name: test_coherence_flag_json_preserves_failing_run_tests_result_in_single_document
artifacts.source_scenario: Structural validation and coherence pass, but a manifest validate command fails while --json output is requested.

expected.behavior: JSON output is one parseable document containing validation, failed tests, and coherence results, and the command exits 1.

artifacts.name: test_coherence_flag_json_preserves_run_tests_result_in_single_document
artifacts.source_scenario: Structural validation, manifest validate commands, and coherence all pass with --json output requested.

expected.behavior: JSON output is one parseable document containing validation, tests, and coherence results, and the command exits 0.

artifacts.name: test_coherence_flag_json_reports_failure_and_exits_1
artifacts.source_scenario: The same coherence failure is requested with --json output.

expected.behavior: JSON output is one parseable document with nested validation and coherence failure details, and the command exits 1.

artifacts.name: test_coherence_flag_json_reports_success_in_single_document
artifacts.source_scenario: Directory-wide structural validation and coherence both pass with --json output requested.

expected.behavior: JSON output is one parseable document with nested validation and coherence success details, and the command exits 0.

artifacts.name: test_coherence_flag_json_returns_2_when_coherence_cannot_run
artifacts.source_scenario: Coherence execution raises an exception after structural validation succeeds with --json output requested.

expected.behavior: The command exits 2 and reports the coherence execution error as one parseable JSON document.

artifacts.name: test_coherence_flag_returns_1_when_coherence_errors
artifacts.source_scenario: Structural validation succeeds, but .maid-constraints.json creates a coherence error.

expected.behavior: maid validate --coherence exits 1 and prints the coherence failure.

artifacts.name: test_coherence_flag_returns_2_when_coherence_cannot_run
artifacts.source_scenario: Coherence execution raises an exception after structural validation succeeds.

expected.behavior: The command exits 2 and reports the coherence execution error instead of swallowing it.

artifacts.name: test_find_test_files_resolves_django_dotted_module_test_label
artifacts.source_scenario: A validate command targets a Django test module through `python manage.py test app.tests.test_module` and the manifest does not list the test file elsewhere.

expected.behavior: find_test_files returns the resolved src-layout Python test file.

artifacts.name: test_implementation_validate_check_stubs_returns_1_for_stub_function
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a function whose body is a pass/ellipsis stub.

expected.behavior: maid validate --check-stubs --fail-on-warnings exits 1 with E310.

artifacts.name: test_schema_mode_cli_returns_1_for_duplicate_yaml_key
artifacts.source_scenario: The CLI validates a manifest with duplicate YAML keys in schema mode.

expected.behavior: maid validate --mode schema exits 1 and prints E003.

artifacts.name: test_validate_all_includes_nested_active_manifest_failure
artifacts.source_scenario: The CLI validates a root manifest directory containing a nested active YML manifest in a neutral subdirectory that fails implementation validation.

expected.behavior: The CLI exits non-zero and prints the nested active manifest failure in the root directory validation result.

artifacts.name: test_validate_allow_empty_returns_0_for_empty_manifest_dir
artifacts.source_scenario: The CLI validates an empty manifest directory with --allow-empty.

expected.behavior: maid validate --allow-empty exits 0 and makes the empty-set choice explicit.

artifacts.name: test_validate_changed_scope_requires_explicit_or_metadata_baseline
artifacts.source_scenario: maid validate --changed-scope runs without --since, --base-ref, or metadata.maid_task_base.

expected.behavior: The command exits non-zero with ErrorCode.CHANGED_SCOPE_BASELINE_REQUIRED and does not mention origin/main.

artifacts.name: test_validate_changed_scope_returns_1_for_changed_read_only_file
artifacts.source_scenario: maid validate --changed-scope runs after a production file changed since metadata.maid_task_base but the file is only in files.read.

expected.behavior: The command exits 1 and prints ErrorCode.CHANGED_FILE_OUTSIDE_MANIFEST_SCOPE with the changed file path.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_accepts_django_admin_dotted_module_test_label
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file and validate runs `django-admin test <dotted module>`.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity treats django-admin as a recognized Django test runner.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_accepts_django_admin_pre_test_settings
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file and validate runs `django-admin --settings project.settings test <dotted module>`.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity recognizes django-admin when value options appear before the test subcommand.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_accepts_django_dotted_module_test_label
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a src-layout Django test file and validate runs `python manage.py test` with the equivalent dotted module label.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns no E230 error.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_accepts_django_top_level_directory_flag
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file and validate runs `python manage.py test <dotted module> -t .`.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity treats Django's short top-level-directory flag as a value flag, not a test selector.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_accepts_docker_exec_django_dotted_module_test_label
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a src-layout Django test file and validate runs the reported `docker exec ... python manage.py test <dotted module>` command.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity treats the docker-wrapped Django command as covering the declared test file.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_accepts_docker_exec_pytest_file_target
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Python test file and validate runs `docker exec ... pytest tests/test_gate.py`.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity scans the docker inner command and treats the pytest file target as covering the declared test file.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_accepts_manage_py_pre_test_settings
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file and validate runs `python manage.py --settings project.settings test <dotted module>`.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity recognizes manage.py when value options appear before the test subcommand.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_accepts_python_module_django_test_label
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file and validate runs `python -m django test <dotted module>`.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity treats python -m django test as a recognized Django test runner.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_accepts_uv_run_project_pytest_file
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest reads a behavioral pytest file and validates it through `uv run --project backend pytest <file> -q`.

expected.behavior: Command integrity returns no E230 error because the command runs the discovered behavioral test file.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_allows_e2e_acceptance_metadata
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest records the same E2E commands in acceptance.tests while validate runs fast behavioral tests.

expected.behavior: No E2E validate-command error is reported because acceptance metadata is not the fast validate stream.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_allows_known_legacy_pytest_node_selector
artifacts.source_scenario: A known pre-cutoff active manifest uses its existing pytest node selector validate command.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity preserves the explicit legacy compatibility path for that manifest.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_keeps_e2e_marker_on_selector_error
artifacts.source_scenario: A validate command uses e2e as a pytest selector value rather than an E2E path or script name.

expected.behavior: Validation reports the existing selector integrity error instead of classifying the selector value as an E2E path.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_detached_docker_django_command
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file but validate runs the docker exec command in detached mode.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 because detached docker exec does not prove the test result.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_django_class_selector_with_top_level_directory
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file but validate targets a narrower Django class selector and also passes `--top-level-directory .`.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 and does not let Django value-flag arguments count as generic path targets.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_django_dotted_class_selector
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file but validate targets a narrower Django class selector within that module.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 because class or method selectors do not prove the whole declared behavioral test file ran.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_django_dotted_option_value
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file but validate puts that dotted module in a Django option value rather than a test label.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 because Django option values do not prove test-file execution.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_django_label_without_tests_package
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares `app/tests/test_module.py` but validate uses the mistyped Django label `app.test_module`.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 because Django dotted labels must map directly to the existing module path.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_django_missing_value_flag_value
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file but validate ends with a Django option that requires a missing value.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 because malformed Django commands do not prove test-file execution.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_django_pre_test_selectors
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file but validate passes `--tag`, `--exclude-tag`, or `-k` before the Django `test` subcommand.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 because pre-subcommand Django selector filters do not prove the whole declared behavioral test file ran.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_django_pythonpath_env_shadowing
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file but validate sets `PYTHONPATH` while using the same dotted label.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 because environment Python path mutation can shadow the in-repo test module.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_django_pythonpath_shadowing
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file but validate mutates the Django test import path with `--pythonpath` while using the same dotted label.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 because Python path mutation can shadow the in-repo test module.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_django_tag_selector
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file but validate filters that module with a Django tag selector.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 because tag selectors do not prove the whole declared behavioral test file ran.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_docker_django_env_file_shadowing
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file but validate injects an env file through docker exec while using the same dotted label.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 because docker env files can shadow the in-repo Django test module through PYTHONPATH.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_docker_django_pythonpath_env_shadowing
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Django test file but validate injects `PYTHONPATH` through docker exec env options while using the same dotted label.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 for docker --env, --env=, -e, and -ePYTHONPATH forms that can shadow the in-repo Django test module.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_docker_wrapper_path_tokens
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a Python test file but docker exec metadata, such as the container name or workdir value, matches a host test directory while the inner pytest command targets an unrelated path.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns E230 because docker wrapper tokens do not prove host test-file execution.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_e2e_validate_commands
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest puts explicit browser/E2E commands in validate.

expected.behavior: Validation reports ErrorCode.E2E_VALIDATE_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED for each E2E validate command.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_js_runner_selectors
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest has a declared JS/TS behavioral test file but validate uses Jest or Playwright selector flags against a containing tests directory.

expected.behavior: validate-command integrity returns VALIDATE_COMMAND_DOES_NOT_RUN_TESTS.

artifacts.name: test_validate_command_integrity_rejects_wrapped_e2e_without_test_files
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest has no discoverable behavioral tests and puts package-manager-wrapped E2E or selector-bearing browser commands in validate.

expected.behavior: Validation still reports ErrorCode.E2E_VALIDATE_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED instead of letting coverage checks skip the command.

artifacts.name: test_validate_empty_manifest_dir_returns_1_by_default
artifacts.source_scenario: The CLI validates an existing manifest directory with no active manifests.

expected.behavior: maid validate exits 1 rather than treating the empty set as success.

artifacts.name: test_validate_file_tracking_gate_returns_1_for_undeclared_source
artifacts.source_scenario: Structural validation succeeds but file tracking finds an undeclared production file.

expected.behavior: maid validate --file-tracking exits 1 and reports the undeclared path.

artifacts.name: test_validate_manifest_changed_scope_uses_selected_manifest_scope
artifacts.source_scenario: maid validate selects one manifest whose files.read contains a changed production file while an unrelated active manifest lists that file in files.edit.

expected.behavior: The command exits 1 and reports the read-only changed file instead of being masked by the unrelated active manifest.

artifacts.name: test_validate_nonexistent_dir_returns_1_by_default
artifacts.source_scenario: The CLI validates a nonexistent manifest directory.

expected.behavior: maid validate exits 1 and prints EMPTY_MANIFEST_SET.

artifacts.name: test_validate_quiet_keeps_policy_created_chain_warnings
artifacts.source_scenario: A valid fixture project has a post-policy date-only or duplicate unsequenced created value.

expected.behavior: main(['validate', '--quiet']) exits 0 and still prints the actionable E118/E119 warning.

artifacts.name: test_validate_quiet_omits_pre_policy_created_chain_warnings
artifacts.source_scenario: A valid fixture project has only pre-policy E118/E119 candidates covering date-only, offset datetime, fractional-second UTC datetime, and duplicate legacy created groups.

expected.behavior: main(['validate', '--quiet']) exits 0 and stdout contains no E118 or E119 lines for any grandfathered warning shape.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_accepts_pytest_directory_covering_test_file
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest has a behavioral test in files.read and validate runs pytest against the containing tests directory.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests proceeds to execute the command.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_accepts_pytest_project_root_covering_test_file
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest has a behavioral test file and validate runs pytest against the project root.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests proceeds to execute the command.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_allows_benign_pytest_config_addopts
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest targets the declared tests and pytest config only adds harmless display options.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests executes normally without command-integrity errors.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_allows_explicit_pytest_config_over_pyproject_addopts
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest targets declared tests with `python -m pytest -c pytest.ini tests -q` while pyproject.toml has selector addopts.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests executes normally because the explicit pytest config overrides pyproject.toml.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_allows_override_ini_addopts_over_pyproject_addopts
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest targets declared tests with `python -m pytest -o addopts= tests -q` while pyproject.toml has selector addopts.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests executes normally because the command-line addopts override replaces pyproject.toml addopts.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_allows_override_ini_addopts_with_explicit_pyproject
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest targets declared tests with `python -m pytest -c pyproject.toml -o addopts= tests -q` while pyproject.toml has selector addopts.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests executes normally because the command-line addopts override replaces pyproject.toml addopts even when pyproject.toml is explicit.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_allows_pytest_ini_precedence_over_pyproject_addopts
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest targets declared tests, pyproject.toml has selector addopts, but pytest.ini takes precedence.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests executes normally without treating ignored pyproject addopts as effective.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_json_includes_test_result
artifacts.source_scenario: A caller requests JSON while run-tests is enabled.

expected.behavior: JSON output contains structural validation data and test command result data.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_json_reports_pyproject_pytest_addopts_integrity_error
artifacts.source_scenario: A caller requests JSON output when pyproject pytest addopts injects a selector that bypasses declared behavioral tests.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_rejects_attached_pytest_selector_skipping_declared_test

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_rejects_backdated_pytest_node_selector
artifacts.source_scenario: A new manifest backdates created before the legacy cutoff and targets only a different pytest node in the declared test file.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests still exits 1 and reports VALIDATE_COMMAND_DOES_NOT_RUN_TESTS.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_rejects_clustered_pytest_selector_skipping_declared_test
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest has a failing declared behavioral test but validate uses a clustered pytest short selector to run only a different passing test.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests exits 1 and reports VALIDATE_COMMAND_DOES_NOT_RUN_TESTS.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_rejects_malformed_pyproject_pytest_addopts
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest targets declared behavioral tests, but pyproject.toml has malformed pytest addopts configuration.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests exits 1 with a visible command-integrity or config-inspection error instead of silently ignoring the malformed config.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_rejects_noop_validate_command
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest has a real behavioral test in files.read but validate contains only a no-op Python command.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests exits 1 and reports VALIDATE_COMMAND_DOES_NOT_RUN_TESTS.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_rejects_noop_with_editable_test_file
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest declares a behavioral test file in files.edit but validate contains only a no-op Python command.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests exits 1 and reports VALIDATE_COMMAND_DOES_NOT_RUN_TESTS.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_rejects_pytest_addopts_non_executing_mode

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_rejects_pytest_addopts_override_ini_selector
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest has a failing declared behavioral test but PYTEST_ADDOPTS injects an override-ini addopts selector.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests exits 1 and reports VALIDATE_COMMAND_DOES_NOT_RUN_TESTS.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_rejects_pytest_addopts_selector
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest has a failing declared behavioral test but validate injects a pytest selector through PYTEST_ADDOPTS.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests exits 1 and reports VALIDATE_COMMAND_DOES_NOT_RUN_TESTS.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_rejects_pytest_config_collect_only
artifacts.source_scenario: A manifest targets `python -m pytest tests -q`, while pyproject pytest addopts injects `--collect-only`.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests exits 1 and reports a structured validate-command integrity error.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_rejects_pytest_config_selector_deselecting_behavioral_test
artifacts.source_scenario: A declared behavioral test would fail if run, but pyproject pytest addopts injects `-k test_other`.

expected.behavior: maid validate --run-tests exits 1 before claiming tests passed.

artifacts.name: test_validate_run_tests_rejects_pytest_node_selector_skipping_declared_test

artifacts.description: Return rendered YAML with MANIFEST_HEADER_COMMENT inserted flush-left above the first YAML key. Idempotent: returns rendered unchanged when the banner already appears in the leading comment block, detected by scanning only that block rather than the whole document so a manifest whose body quotes the banner still gets one, and comparing each line with trailing whitespace stripped so an editor-scuffed banner is still recognized rather than stacked. Inserts the banner immediately after a leading '# draft-kind:' or '# archive-kind:' marker line when one is present, otherwise at the very top. Makes no other modification to rendered.

artifacts.name: validate
artifacts.description: Drop the re-export resolution cache at the start of every daemon request. The daemon holds one validation scope open for its whole lifetime, so the scope-boundary clear never fires after construction and the cache would otherwise answer from a resolution taken before the source changed. Per-request clearing keeps the full intra-run benefit because every resolution burst happens inside one request.
